_comment: How the game turns data/downtown.geojson into a town. Coordinates are never typed here: places are named by the streets that meet there, and the game looks them up in the OSM data.

origin._comment: World (0,0,0). This is the OSM position of the Great George Street / Richmond Street junction (node 8598664). Keep it fixed when the map grows so existing coordinates stay valid.

play_area._comment: The four corners of the playable area, as street pairs, in order around the edge. The invisible boundary sits margin_m outside the line joining them.

spawn._comment: The player starts on the sidewalk at this junction.

road_defaults._comment: Curb-to-curb width and sidewalk width in metres, by OSM highway class.

street_overrides._comment: Widths measured against OSM building footprints (median gap between building fronts across each street, inside the play area). Curb + sidewalk must stay inside that gap.
